title: 第21章 运筹帷幄5第22章 运筹帷幄6
content_zh:
次日，阳光如火焰般炽热。
这天乃是起源6180年7月5日，清晨，太阳便已如熊熊燃烧的火球，释放出无尽的酷热。
追梦领着合欢宗第8长老柳虎、丹鼎宗第9长老宋峰、烈阳门第7长老邹毅飞，快马加鞭，快速的来到邹家村。
此时的邹家村，这数月来，犹如勤劳的蜜蜂，长期为追梦家供应着代芳河里新鲜的鱼肉，因而获得了邹家酒楼鱼肉销售赚取银钱的四成利润。
再加上邹家村紧邻代芳河，犹如受到了上天的眷顾，此次旱灾对其影响微乎其微，生活水平节节攀升，村中武力水平更是如春笋般迅速提升，皆已达到4级精英武者的境界。
精盐的制作，需要大量的人力。
这些普通的佣人，追梦计划在邹家村招募。
追梦等人刚踏入村子，众村民便如被惊扰的蜂群，开始骚动起来，村长则如热锅上的蚂蚁，急忙迎了上来，激动得声音都有些颤抖：“追梦小子，您来了。”
追梦微微颔首，犹如审视自己杰作的艺术家，环视了一圈周围如铁塔般健壮的村民们，心中暗自满意。
“村长，此次前来，是想给大家一个如金子般闪耀的赚钱机会。
我要制作精盐，犹如建造一座宏伟的宫殿，需要大量人力去开采粗盐矿，报酬之丰厚，定能让大家满载而归。”
追梦的声音如洪钟般响亮，在村子上空回荡。
村民们一听，顿时如炸开了锅，议论声此起彼伏，眼中满是如火焰般燃烧的跃跃欲试。
接着追梦又高声说道：“你们不必担忧危险，我特意派遣了三位7级精英武士级高手，为大家保驾护航。”
这时，村长看向追梦，低声说道：“追梦小子，这么多人都去挖矿，会不会如抽走了村子的筋骨，影响村子其他事务？”
追梦笑道：“无妨，工钱将如甘霖般按劳力分配，而且可以轮流前去，既能让村里的事务有条不紊地进行，又能让大家如获至宝般多一份收入。”
村民们激动得如孩子般热泪盈眶，各个都迫不及待地应下此事。
随后追梦又详细交代了一些关键事宜，便在村长的引领下，如众星捧月般带着众人来到村后山的粗盐矿地。
出现在追梦眼前的，是几座植被稀稀拉拉、叶片枯黄如蝶的山峰。
追梦凭借着穿越前21世纪的记忆，经过一番仔细地核对和检测，最终确定这无疑是一个超级大的露天盐矿，对追梦来说，宛如一座沉睡的宝藏。

盐矿确定后，新的难题又摆在追梦面前。
首先，开采盐矿现有的小路狭窄得犹如羊肠小道，已完全无法满足需求，必须修建一条宽阔如大路的马路，这样使用工具搬运肯定会比人力一担一担地挑快上许多。
其次，选择何种工具搬运成了关键，这个世界目前使用的是马车、牛车、驴车，这些工具效率低下。
最后，制作精盐场地的选择也至关重要。
经过一番深思熟虑后，追梦当机立断，命柳虎、宋峰、邹毅飞三人负责一路的突发事件，把邹家村众人分为三部分。
第一部分人负责自挖自送，也就说自己挖掘粗盐矿，并把自己挖掘到的粗盐矿送到柳城。
酬金按100斤粗盐1罐钱计算，多劳多得，如同丰收的果实。
第二部分人，负责修建马路。
酬金按1两银钱修建5米计算，对于那些比较难修和特殊的路段，追梦让村长根据实际情况酌情开价。
第三部分人则跟随追梦回家，待精盐制作场地确定好后，负责制作精盐的一道道工序。
当然，最关键的工序还是由追梦、邹铁牛和柳淼花三人完成。
这个世上虽有精盐，但质量差强人意，价格更是贵如黄金，普通人根本无法承受，市价1斤精盐1两黄金，简直就是天价。
考虑到安全因素，追梦向李志强购买了一块地，这块地紧邻城主府，安全系数自然是毋庸置疑的。
精盐的制作过程一帆风顺。
当天下午，邹家村负责送粗盐矿的人匆匆忙忙的送来了上万斤粗盐矿。
追梦在现场指挥，教导，当天就成功产出了近九千斤精盐。
追梦在柳城找到一个镖局，负责押送这次制作的精盐，去阿弥彦皇朝。
追梦跟着镖局一同出发。
明面上邹家只出动了三，追梦、追梦的临时贴身护卫西门雪、来学习精盐销售的柳媚娘。
暗中追梦派酒肉和尚鲁达达、银毒婆婆宋茜、隐藏高手熊二龟，三人一路护航。

content_en:
The next day, the sun was as hot as fire.
This day was July 5, 6180. In the early morning, the sun was already like a blazing fireball, releasing endless heat.
Zhui Meng led Liu Hu, the 8th elder of the Hehuan Sect, Song Feng, the 9th elder of the Danding Sect, and Zou Yifei, the 7th elder of the Lieyang Sect, and quickly arrived at Zoujia Village.
At this time, Zoujia Village has been like industrious bees in the past few months, supplying the Dream Chasers with fresh fish from the Daifang River, and thus obtained 40% of the silver profit earned from the fish sales in Zoujia Restaurant.
In addition, Zoujiacun is close to the Daifang River, and it seems to have been favored by God. The drought has had minimal impact on it. Living standards have been rising steadily. The level of martial arts in the village has mushroomed like bamboo shoots, and they have all reached the level of a level 4 elite warrior.
The production of refined salt requires a lot of manpower.
These ordinary servants were recruited by the Dream Chaser Project in Zoujia Village.
As soon as Meng Zhui and others entered the village, the villagers started to commotion like a swarm of disturbed bees. The village chief hurriedly came up to them like ants on a hot pot, his voice trembling with excitement: "Dream Boy, you are here."
Zhui Meng nodded slightly, like an artist examining his own masterpiece, and looked around at the villagers who were as strong as iron towers, feeling secretly satisfied.
“Village Chief, I came here this time to give you a chance to make money that shines like gold.
I want to make refined salt, which is like building a magnificent palace. It requires a lot of manpower to mine coarse salt mines. The rich rewards will definitely make everyone return home with a full load. "
The voice of chasing dreams was as loud as a bell, echoing over the village.
When the villagers heard this, they immediately felt like a pot was exploding. Discussions broke out one after another, and their eyes were filled with eagerness to try, burning like a flame.
Then Meng Zhui said loudly: "You don't have to worry about danger. I specially dispatched three level 7 elite warrior masters to protect everyone."
At this time, the village chief looked at Dream Chaser and whispered: "Dream Chaser boy, with so many people going to mine, will it be like taking away the bones and bones of the village and affecting other affairs of the village?"
Zhui Meng smiled and said: "It doesn't matter, the wages will be distributed according to labor like rain, and you can go there in turns, which will not only allow the affairs of the village to proceed in an orderly manner, but also give everyone an extra income like a treasure."
The villagers were as excited as children with tears in their eyes, and everyone couldn't wait to accept this.
Zhui Meng then explained some key matters in detail, and under the guidance of the village chief, he led everyone to the coarse salt mine in the mountain behind the village like stars holding the moon.
What appeared in front of Dream Chaser were several mountain peaks with sparse vegetation and withered and yellow leaves like butterflies.
Zhui Meng relied on his memories of traveling back to the 21st century, and after careful checking and testing, he finally determined that this was undoubtedly a super large open-pit salt mine. To Zhui Meng, it was like a sleeping treasure.
After the salt mine was confirmed, new problems posed before Dream Chaser.
First of all, the existing paths for mining salt mines are as narrow as catwalks and cannot meet the demand at all. A road as wide as a road must be built. In this way, the use of tools will definitely be much faster than manpower carrying one load after another.
Secondly, the choice of transportation tools has become the key. The world currently uses horse-drawn carriages, ox-carts, and donkey carts, and these tools are inefficient.
Finally, the choice of the site for making refined salt is also crucial.
After careful consideration, Zhui Meng made a decisive decision and ordered Liu Hu, Song Feng, and Zou Yifei to take charge of emergencies along the way, and divided the people in Zoujia Village into three parts.
The first group of people are responsible for digging and delivering the salt themselves, that is to say, they dig the coarse salt mines themselves and deliver the coarse salt they dig to Liucheng.
The remuneration is calculated based on one can of 100 kilograms of coarse salt. The more you work, the more you get, just like the fruits of the harvest.
The second group of people is responsible for building roads.
The remuneration is calculated based on 1 tael of silver to build 5 meters. For those sections that are more difficult to repair and special, Dream Chaser allows the village chief to take root.Pricing will be made based on actual circumstances.
The third group of people followed Chai Meng home, and after the refined salt production site was determined, they were responsible for the various processes of making refined salt.
Of course, the most critical process is completed by Zhui Meng, Zou Tieniu and Liu Miaohua.
Although there is refined salt in this world, the quality is unsatisfactory, and the price is as expensive as gold. Ordinary people cannot afford it. The market price is 1 tael of gold per kilogram of refined salt, which is simply astronomical.
Considering safety factors, Zhui Meng purchased a piece of land from Li Zhiqiang. This land was close to the city lord's palace, so there was no doubt about its safety factor.
The process of making refined salt was smooth sailing.
In the afternoon of that day, the person responsible for delivering coarse salt ore in Zoujiacun hurriedly delivered tens of thousands of kilograms of coarse salt ore.
Zhuimeng directed and taught on site, and successfully produced nearly nine thousand kilograms of refined salt that day.
Zhui Meng found an escort agency in Liucheng, responsible for escorting the refined salt produced this time to the Amihiko Dynasty.
Chai Meng sets out with the escort agency.
On the surface, the Zou family only dispatched three people, Ximen Xue, the temporary personal guard of Zhui Meng, and Liu Meiniang, who came to learn how to sell refined salt.
Lu Dada, a drunkard monk from the dream-chasing sect, Song Qian, a silver-poisoned mother-in-law, and Xiong Ergui, a master of concealment, escorted him all the way.
